It discusses the general threat landscape, the difference between vulnerabilities and malware, and how Sonatype's product proactively blocks suspicious or malicious components from entering the software supply chain. No specific malicious package or code is analyzed.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for components flagged as suspicious or malicious by behavioral analysis tools. Use automated policy enforcement to quarantine or block components exhibiting abnormal or high-risk behaviors. Regularly review and update risk-based policies to ensure only approved and safe components are allowed into the SDLC.
